semiconductor_relevance: High — Gallant Precision Machining Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in polishing and image inspection technologies.
summary: Gallant Precision Machining Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on polishing machines and automated optical inspection (AOI) systems. With a strong presence in Taiwan and Mainland China, they deliver innovative solutions that support cutting-edge packaging technologies.
capabilities: Automated optical inspection (AOI) equipment for various types
Equipment supporting advanced packaging technologies such as SiP and Fan-Out
High-performance bond head systems for 3D IC processes

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has its headquarters and manufacturing centers in Taiwan's Hsinchu Science Park and Central Taiwan Science Park.
regional_presence.China: GPM operates a manufacturing center in Suzhou, Mainland China.
